purpose: Fail-closed handoff from the isolated EUCONS research runtime export into the NF06 analytical schema, without admitting identifiers or synthetic rows into PROD evidence.

raw_record_envelope.response_id: server-generated random opaque identifier with no identity lookup table

adult_answers.privacy_ack: derive true only from the EUCONS runtime acceptance invariant: public submissions are rejected unless notice_read_and_voluntary_participation=true

employer_answers.E03_matrix: split into the seven E03 analytical dimensions
employer_answers.privacy_ack: derive true only from the EUCONS runtime acceptance invariant

canonical_transform.received_at: normalize to RFC3339 UTC Z in received_at_utc

pii_text_screen.note: Automated screening is a safety net, not proof of anonymity; free-text review remains required before quotation/publication.

fail_closed_conditions: invalid JSON or unsupported top-level structure
missing or unexpected raw envelope field
synthetic is not false in PROD
forbidden key present anywhere in raw record
PII-like token found in raw or normalized free text
any expected region absent when declaring the three-region coverage gate closed

outputs.normalized_jsonl: validated transformed records only; pseudonymous research artifact outside public git
outputs.ingest_report_json: raw hash, normalized hash, input/valid/rejected counts, region/strata counts, errors and coverage gate
outputs.evidence_promotion: FORBIDDEN until technical PASS plus documented recruitment frame/coverage metadata, immutable raw manifest and raw-to-aggregate reconciliation

validation_receipt.note: Synthetic fixtures validate software behavior only and remain NON-EVIDENCE. No fixture values enter the PROD evidence registry.
